sources.title: Burning and Suppression of Solids II (BASS-II)

warnings: PSI tables for BASS and BASS-II have no outcome column; "outcomes_reported" counts operator notes (ext, blowoff, no ign) only.
PSI has no partial-gravity combustion data (challenge statement). Lunar values in the gravity curve come from NTRS, not PSI.
Two BASS-II final O2 readings (P22b 39.1%, T28b 40.4%) are sensor errors; only initial O2 is used.

lunar_habitat_reference.planned_value: 34% O2 at 8.2 psi (Fortenberry et al., NASA fire detection white paper)

o2_ceiling.message: No solid sample in the PSI tables of BASS-II or Saffire I-III was tested above 22.2% oxygen.
